hero.subtitle: One screen tells you where every job stands, who's blocked, and what needs your attention today. No status calls, no chasing updates. Just clarity.

problem.heading: The status call is stealing your day
problem.body: Every day, owners and managers spend hours chasing updates. Who's blocked? What's late? When will it be done? The answer is buried in messages, calls, and memory — not somewhere you can actually see it.
problem.footer: Built for SME owners and operations managers who need the truth about their work, not another meeting.

cta.heading: Ready to get clarity?
cta.subtitle: Start now. No credit card required.

productPricing.heading: See what's included. Know what it costs.
productPricing.subheading: Start with the base plan and add only what your team needs.

job-tracking.name: Job tracking
job-tracking.description: See all your jobs across milestones in one place. Filter by status, priority, or assignee. Group by milestone to track progress at a glance — no spreadsheets, no chasing.

blockage.name: Blockage visibility
blockage.description: When a job is blocked, you see exactly why, who flagged it, and since when. No more hunting through messages to find out what's stuck.

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Status distribution, overdue jobs, and pending approvals in one screen. Open the dashboard and you know exactly where the project stands.

approvals.name: Approvals
approvals.description: Structured sign-off directly on the job. Employees request, you decide, everything is logged permanently with your comment. No ambiguity about what was decided or when.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Add decisions and agreements directly to any job. Notes are permanent and timestamped — your record of what was said and decided. Once written, they're part of the permanent record.

history.name: Job status history
history.description: See the complete history of every status change on any job — who moved it, when, and why it was blocked. Full accountability, no gaps.

milestones.name: Milestones
milestones.description: Organise jobs into delivery phases with deadlines and progress tracking. See exactly how much of each milestone is done at a glance.

relationships.name: Job relationships
relationships.description: Define how jobs relate to each other — blocked by, blocks, or related to. See what a blocked job is waiting on and trace dependencies across your project.

templates.name: Job templates
templates.description: Save frequently created jobs as templates and spin them up in one click. Consistent structure, zero repeated effort.

recurring.name: Recurring scheduling
recurring.description: Set up recurring jobs that create themselves automatically — daily, weekly, or monthly. Requires Job templates.

api-keys.name: API keys
api-keys.description: Generate scoped API keys for integrations and automation — pull job data into your own tools or scripts without going through the UI.
